name: Marius Hills Hole and rille
provider: U.S. Geological Survey Astrogeology Science Center
source_product_id: Fortezzo et al. (2020) Unified Geologic Map of the Moon / GeoUnits_Mercator
map_unit_description: Forms high standing plateaus (relative to the mare surfaces in Oceanus Procellarum) with domes, cones, and dark mantling materials.
map_unit_interpretation: Volcanic constructs, flows, and pyroclatic materials.
coordinate_reference_system: Moon_2000 geographic projected to spherical Mercator; R=1,737,400 m; central meridian 0°
source_description: The USGS unified map aggregates 49 lunar geologic units from six regional maps. Mapped interpretation is regional context at 1:5M scale, not a local assay, mineral detection, regolith composition measurement, or engineering property.
